about.title: About Beachside Circle Boats
about.subtitle: Experience a new way to explore Orange Beach
about.description: Beachside Circle Boats brings a whole new way to experience Orange Beach. Our portable, eco-friendly electric circle boats are perfect for cruising the intercoastal waterways — no gas, no noise, just pure fun on the water.
about.perfectFor: Families, couples, birthday parties, group outings, fishing, or just relaxing on the water. No boating license needed!

products.name: Single Seater
products.description: Solo cruiser. 57 lbs, portable, 35lb electric motor. Fits one adult up to 300 lbs.

products.name: Double Seater
products.description: Bring a friend. 65 lbs, extra-wide seats, enhanced stability. Fits two adults up to 450 lbs combined.

group_rate.title: Group Rates Available
group_rate.description: Rent 5 or more single seaters and save. No group rate on doubles. Call to book.

docks.name: Mini Dock
docks.description: The full-size floating platform. Tow it behind your GoBoat for extra room to sunbathe, do yoga, spread out a picnic, or store all your beach gear. Plenty of space for two adults to lounge comfortably.
features: Large flat platform for lounging & sunbathing

docks.name: X Dock
docks.description: The compact square dock built for utility. Designed to hold a full-size cooler (up to 58 quarts), tackle boxes, or a portable grill. Frees up all the legroom in your GoBoat so passengers ride in comfort.
features: Holds a 58-qt cooler with room to spare
Raised edge rails prevent items from sliding

docks.name: Doggie Dock
docks.description: Built for your four-legged crew. Features a weighted mesh ramp so dogs can climb in and out of the water on their own. Non-slip surface keeps paws steady, and the dock stays flat even with a jumping pup.
features: Weighted mesh entry/exit ramp for dogs
Non-slip grip surface for wet paws
Stable — won't flip when dogs jump on/off
Pairs great with our Pup Pack add-on

items.name: Marcus T.
items.text: Best boat rental experience in Orange Beach! The circle boats are so unique and fun. My kids absolutely loved it. Staff was super friendly and helpful getting us set up. Will definitely be back next summer!

items.name: Sarah K.
items.text: We rented the double seater for a half day and it was incredible! So easy to operate and the electric motor is whisper quiet. Perfect for a chill day on the water. The portable dock was a game changer too.

items.name: Jake R.
items.text: Took my dog out on the circle boat with the doggie dock attachment. He loved it! It's the only boat rental I've found that's actually pet-friendly in a practical way. Great concept, great people.

items.name: Amanda L.
items.text: We booked the all-day rental for our family reunion and everyone had an absolute blast. The boats are safe, clean, and so much fun. Already booked again for Memorial Day weekend. 10/10 recommend!

items.name: Derek W.
items.text: These circle boats are something else! Never seen anything like them. Super stable, easy to drive, and the electric motor has plenty of power. The inflatable design means you can take it anywhere. A+ experience.

items.name: Rachel M.
items.text: Perfect date night idea! We took the double seater out for a sunset cruise and it was magical. So peaceful and romantic. The staff even helped us pick the best time for sunset views. Can't wait to go again!
